## README.md
# Field boundaries for Portugal

Open field boundaries (identificação de parcelas) from Portugal in 2023.
Provides ca. 4.8 million official field boundaries from the Instituto de Financiamento da Agricultura e Pescas in Portugal.
It has been converted to a fiboa-compliant GeoParquet file.

- **Source Data Provider:** [IPAP - Instituto de Financiamento da Agricultura e Pescas](https://www.ifap.pt/isip/ows/)
- **Converted by:** [Matthias Mohr](https://mohr.ws)
- **License:** [No conditions apply](https://inspire.ec.europa.eu/metadata-codelist/ConditionsApplyingToAccessAndUse/noConditionsApply)

---

- **[Download the data as fiboa GeoParquet](https://data.source.coop/fiboa/portugal/Continente.parquet)**
- [STAC Browser](https://radiantearth.github.io/stac-browser/#/external/data.source.coop/fiboa/portugal/stac/collection.json)
- [STAC Collection](https://data.source.coop/fiboa/portugal/stac/collection.json)
- [PMTiles](https://data.source.coop/fiboa/portugal/Continente.pmtiles)

## Lineage

- Data downloaded on 2024-08-13 from https://www.ifap.pt/isip/ows/resources/2023/Continente.gpkg.
- Converted to GeoParquet using [fiboa-cli](https://github.com/fiboa/cli), version 0.6.0.
